{{Quote|Karpette, front and center!|Captain Atar|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Karpette''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] member of [[Galactic Alliance Security]], in which she served under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], she was part of the Security force sent to apprehend the [[Force psychosis|afflicted]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] and [[Bazel Warv]]. A warrant for the arrest of the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was drawn up, and Karpette held it for Atar. However, due to the intervention of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]], their daughter, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], Karpette and the rest of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were unsuccessful in capturing the Jedi.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I don't see anyone in imminent danger, and that means you would need a warrant to arrest them. We're not going anywhere unless I see one.|Leia Organa Solo, on Yaqeel Saav'etu and Bazel Warv|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Karpette was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and a member of [[Galactic Alliance Security]]<ref name="Abyss" /> in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third instalment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> She served in a security [[Squad/Legends|squad]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]]. Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] were stricken with a [[Force psychosis|mysterious psychosis]] that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors.<ref name="Abyss" /> The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to deal with the matter by [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encasing]] the affected [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>

[[File:Leia_FOTJdppdf.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Jedi Leia Organa Solo (pictured) attempted to stop Captain Atar and Karpette from arresting Jedi Knights Saav'etu and Warv.]]
That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Jedi Knights [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] developed this psychosis but were quickly incapacitated by [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and Solo's parents, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], outside of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|speeder entrance]] of the [[New Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Karpette and the rest of Atar's forces were nearby, and a warrant was quickly made out for the arrest of Warv and Saav'etu, Karpette printing a small version using a miniature printer.<ref name="Abyss" />

With Karpette in possession of the warrant, the Security force confronted Fel and the Solos outside the Temple, and Atar requested that the Jedi hand Warv and Saav'etu over. Leia refused, demanding to see a warrant, and Atar ordered Karpette to step forward and hand him the warrant. Faced with no other option, Han and Leia then stalled for time by reentering the Jedi Temple and closing the gate behind them as Fel and Jaina left the scene in Fel's [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]], using Fel's diplomatic immunity to prevent the Security forces from blocking their exit and leaving Karpette and the rest of Atar's force empty-handed.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Yes, Captain?''"<br />"''The warrant.|Karpette and Atar|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Karpette took joy in her duties, and she was exceptionally delighted when Atar called her forward to present the warrant.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Equipment==
While persuing Jedi Saav'etu and Warv, Karpette wore an [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] that had a miniature printer on it, using the device to print a warrant for the Jedi.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karpette appeared in [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Abyss" />
